author: nonretail_writer
central_thesis: The disinflation rally has already done the easing the Fed refuses to deliver: the 10Y Treasury is 42 bps lower over 20 observations at 4.41%, VIX sits at 13.35 and DXY is down 2.52%, while Tuesday's minutes say rates must stay high and hedge-fund crowding is at a record. Positioning should therefore shift from chasing rate relief to owning margin- and policy-backed earnings (AI infrastructure, off-price retail, miners, Polish banks on EU money and a strong złoty) with cheap protection, while fading housing-linked and low-end discretionary names, European autos and China property.
sources_policy: Facts come only from own-date headlines cited in the same part (exact [[nNNNN]] ids from tools/digest.py 2023-11-22) or from the 2023-11-22 writer card (completed sessions, all dated 2023-11-21; Treasury prior close 2023-11-21; crypto prior completed daily close 2023-11-21). Records with day-granular placeholder times dated 2023-11-21 were used only where the event plausibly completed before 2023-11-22 00:00 UTC (FOMC minutes and the Wall Street close, Nvidia after-close results, Lowe's pre-market results, existing-home sales, Bullock remarks, Polish industry/wage data, the EU recovery-fund decision, the Binance charges). No numeric spot-FX quotes; currency direction only from cited headlines. Exclusions n1726 and n2107 not cited. Citations kept to roughly 110 distinct ids so each cited fact carries analysis. Background knowledge used only for general mechanisms.
known_ambiguities_omitted: Nvidia's after-hours share reaction to its Q3 results: no eligible headline, so no reaction is stated; the card NVDA close is pre-reaction.
OpenAI leadership outcome after the Microsoft hire is not stated; only the Microsoft hire/offer headlines are used.
Binance settlement terms (amount, plea) are not stated; headlines establish only criminal charges and that CZ is now ex-CEO.
Headlines with numeric FX levels (n1824 'below 4 zł', n1712 'under 5 zł', n1591 'below 150 yen') are not quoted; only direction is used.
n1735 (Money.pl, 2024 budget with record deficit under a 'War in Ukraine' tag) is ambiguous between the Polish and Ukrainian parliaments; not used.
Italy's Moody's review outcome (n1411 is only a preview) is not stated.
Dutch election, Black Friday and spot-bitcoin-ETF outcomes are treated as pending; no results asserted.
Israel-Hamas hostage-deal approval is not stated; n1527 only says release has gotten closer.
Marta Kightley (n1815) and the unnamed NBP first deputy president (n1799) may be the same person; only n1815 is used to avoid double-counting.
Kotecki's institutional role is not stated; he is attributed only by name via Rzeczpospolita (n1750).
No October China credit (new loans/TSF) release headline exists; Credit Impulse relies on sectoral-loan, yuan-financing and LPR evidence.

n0256 (LPR unchanged) carries a 2023-11-19 placeholder although the fixing occurs on Monday 2023-11-20 Beijing time; and n0067/n0022 (RBA) carry placeholders that precede the events they describe. Events are before the cutoff, so they are safe for this edition; n0067 was not cited.
